name: anima
description: Anime and illustration model supporting booru tags and natural language. Slower than Anima Turbo, but higher quality with better adherence to artist styles (2B, ~4GB VRAM)
prompt_guide:
This tool generates illustrated/anime images using the Anima model via ComfyUI.
Anima supports a mix of booru tags and natural language prompting.
Prompts MUST follow this order:

@artist, masterpiece, best quality, [character] from [series/game/etc],
[description of the character], [tags or NLP describing the scene]

Use the @ prefix for artist styles ({artist_list}).
Use booru-style tags for specific information like body type, positions,
and camera angles. Use natural language for complex scene composition.
IMPORTANT: Tags use spaces, NOT underscores (e.g. 'long hair' not 'long_hair').
Always start with 'masterpiece, best quality'.
Never write a short prompt: use at least 10 tags (more is fine), covering the subject, the setting, the lighting and the composition.
Note: Text later in the prompt has MORE effect, so put the most important details at the end.{lora_triggers}

IMPORTANT: Anima cannot render text in images. If the user needs text in an illustration, generate the image without text first, then use the edit_image tool to add text.

inputs.text: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, blurry, jpeg artifacts, sepia, mask, black face, scaled face, watermark, signature
